Compare spatial clusters

compare_spatial_clusters.Rd

Performs differential expression and gene ontology enrichment analysis between two BANKSY-derived spatial clusters.

Differentially expressed genes are identified using Seurat::FindMarkers(), followed by Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment analysis of genes upregulated in the first cluster. GO enrichment results are visualised using dotplot and cnetplot summaries.

Usage

compare_spatial_clusters(
  xenium.obj,
  ident_1,
  ident_2,
  cluster_col = "banksy_clusters",
  assay = "Xenium",
  slot = "data",
  p_adj_cutoff = 0.01,
  show_category = 10
)

Arguments

xenium.obj

Xenium object including BANKSY cluster metadata

ident_1

Cluster identifier of interest

ident_2

Reference cluster identifier

cluster_col

Metadata column containing spatial cluster assignments

assay

Assay used for differential expression

slot

Data slot used for differential expression

p_adj_cutoff

Adjusted p-value threshold

show_category

Number of GO terms displayed in enrichment plots

Value

A list containing differential expression results, GO enrichment results and associated visualisations.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Compare Cluster 1 vs 2
cluster1v2 <- compare_spatial_clusters(
  xenium.obj,
  ident_1 = "1",
  ident_2 = "2")} # }
